difficulty.description: Official sources describe mostly forest, normally good surface, short wet or difficult sections that require boots even in normal conditions, large elevation differences, 110 m height difference, and a surface split of about 35 percent asphalt/gravel road and 65 percent tractor road/path.

seasonalHazards: Official sources say short wet or difficult sections can require boots even in normal conditions.
Large elevation differences and red/difficult grading make this a more strenuous stage than sections 1-3.
Rya åsar has steep/high ridge terrain and summer grazing cattle.
Fire risk changes seasonally; refresh SÄRF/Brandrisk Ute before relying on any fireplace.

Rya åsar endpoint-area route mentions forest footpath, signs, confusing/missing signposts and muddy/old bridge-pole context.

lanes.summary: Confirmed official labels, 13 km, 3.5 h, difficult/red, 110 m height difference, 35% asphalt/gravel and 65% tractor road/path, SOK-stugan/Rya åsar endpoint coordinates, Källeberg/Ramshulan/Rya åsar facilities and reserve restrictions.

Audited Naturkartan GPX/API and OSM relation 4176439. Naturkartan GPX has 417 points, computed 12.977 km, no >500 m gaps and clean joins to stages 3 and 5. OSM is continuous but reversed and uses Borås access endpoints.
Found strong facility candidates at Källeberg, Hestrastugan, Rya åsar Fjällsjön, Högplatån/Björbobacken, Ramshulan and Rya åsar entrance; flagged SOK utilities and Ramshulan water as pending.

Identified Skogshill övre/Sandared station for SOK-stugan access and Ekerydavägen/Björbostugan/Ryda for Rya åsar access, with Västtrafik line 151 and 19 context and endpoint/access-cluster distinctions.

Found recent 2025 AllTrails and Naturkartan reports indicating good boardwalks, good signage, well-maintained/very good conditions and easy parking, plus older reports/blogs for Källeberg and Rya åsar context. No current closure found.

Confirmed Rya åsar reserve overlap in the final section, reserve rules, no current reserve news/closure, fire-ban authority and dynamic fire status, dog/livestock notes, no confirmed potable water and wet/steep seasonal hazards.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Section 4 is strong enough for normalization review with caveats. No second agent batch needed; remaining gaps are import-policy decisions and volatile data refreshes rather than source-discovery blockers.

importReadiness.summary: Section 4 has enough official source, GPX/OSM geometry, commute/access, facilities, rules and field-report evidence for a normalization pass. It is not ready for direct runtime import because endpoint semantics, QA/currentness contradiction, SOK-stugan utility access, Ramshulan water potability and Rya åsar facility-cluster deduplication remain.
importReadiness.descriptionDraft: Etapp 4 runs from SOK-stugan/Nordtorp toward Rya åsar through mostly forest with larger height differences than the earlier stages. The route passes the Källeberg cultural landscape and rest hut, continues toward Hestrastugan and enters the Rya åsar nature reserve for the final stretch. Facilities are strongest at Källeberg and around Rya åsar/Fjällsjön/Högplatån/Ramshulan, but water should not be treated as confirmed potable. Expect some wet or difficult sections even in normal conditions and follow Rya åsar reserve rules near the end.
importReadiness.recommendedGeometry: Use Naturkartan Etapp 4 GPX as primary geometry in official SOK-stugan-to-Rya-åsar direction; use OSM relation 4176439 only as a cross-check after reversing its direction and preserving endpoint-offset notes.
importReadiness.recommendedEndpointPolicy: Use Naturkartan GPX endpoints for route continuity. Model SOK-stugan/Nordtorp and Rya åsar/Björbobacken/Björbostugan/Ramshulan as access/facility clusters, not as replacement geometry vertices unless the normalizer intentionally prioritizes access coordinates over section continuity.
recommendedFacilityPolicy: Import Källeberg rest hut/fireplace and Rya åsar Fjällsjön shelter as strong shelter/rest records.
Import Rya åsar entrance, Högplatån/Björbobacken and Ramshulan as end-area facility/access clusters after deduplicating nearby fireplace/shelter/picnic objects.
Keep SOK-stugan utilities suppressed/pending unless public hiker access is verified.
Keep Ramshulan water pending and do not import as drinking water.
Treat Kvarnbäcken and Källeberg fossil farmland as POI/context records rather than core utilities.
Model Hestrastugan and Borås Camping as nearby access/service metadata only if that scope is wanted.
majorCaveats: Naturkartan/STF QA and reroute warnings conflict with Västsverige stage 3-7 quality-assured statement.
Both section endpoints have about 186-200 m offset between Naturkartan continuity vertices and Borås/OSM access coordinates.
Rya åsar reserve rules prohibit tenting/caravan setup and restrict fires to designated places.
SOK-stugan clubhouse utilities are not confirmed as public hiker facilities.
Ramshulan water is not confirmed potable.
Rya åsar entrance/Högplatån/Sjötorp facility records need deduplication before import.
importReadiness.nextSafeStep: Commit this section packet, then proceed to section 5 six-agent batch.
